entities.title: zazzle
entities.summary: zazzle, a launcher for coding agents and developers, and the tools it runs, mostly for macOS: the daemon and Rust tools, the C launcher, and the C# tools.
entities.purpose: Holds the tools (src/macos), the release scripts (release) that the CI and release scripts of the continuous_integration_and_delivery repository run, and the agent skills and instructions for using them. The tools share a repository, a Cargo workspace and one release, not an architecture. Only zazzle (and its short name z) goes on PATH; every other tool runs as `zazzle TOOL`. Where one uses another, the code says so: the zazzle launcher is the client of the daemon and execs the other tools from libexec/zazzle, and the daemon asks csharp-indexer's daemon for the terse view of C# files. fix-network and free-disk-space call no other tool, and shell-tools is a library inside the daemon.
boundaries: Each tool is documented in its own folder under src/macos: fix-network, free-disk-space, git-tools, ai-agent, ai-agent-rules, daemon with zazzle and the shell-tools library it links, csharp-indexer and csharp-minifier.
The Homebrew formula is not kept here: the release writes it into the external tap zazzcat/homebrew-z; release/README.md documents how.
Meta/Agents/ is a copy of human-assisted-software-development's Agents/Skills and Agents/Knowledge. It is changed in that repository and copied here, and has no .dev folder.
The download site icelander.net/downloads, the GitHub releases and the tap are outside the repository; release.sh in continuous_integration_and_delivery publishes to them.

CI and the release pipeline are not here: they are the zazzle folder of the continuous_integration_and_delivery repository, run by hand. .dev/pipeline.json records CI, release/.dev/pipeline.json the release.
